criteria.requirement: Support existing CLI --renderer ast by serializing the actual list of token dictionaries as UTF8 JSON on stdout or --output. Preserve input priority, explicit/piped empty documents as [], source Unicode, nested token attributes and configured plugins; do not stringify Python repr or wrap JSON in HTML. Existing html/markdown/rst/version behavior and file/stdout side effects stay compatible. Use the completed empty-document fix as prerequisite; errors still yield a nonzero process status.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
